sections.heading: AI model customization and gateway tools

items.title: Amazon SageMaker AI now supports serverless model customization for Muse Glimmer, Qwen 3.8 and Ministral 3 models
items.blurb: Amazon SageMaker AI now supports serverless model customization for Muse Glimmer, Qwen3.8 27B, and Ministral 3 3B, 8B, and 14B models.

items.title: AgentCore Gateway now supports Bedrock InvokeModel APIs and model fallback
items.blurb: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway now supports the Amazon Bedrock InvokeModel and InvokeModelWithResponseStream APIs on its inference endpoint, along with model fallback routing for inference traffic.

items.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service introduces intelligent ingestion for logs and documents in Amazon S3
items.blurb: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now offers intelligent ingestion, a fully managed feature that turns logs and documents stored in Amazon S3 into searchable content in Amazon OpenSearch Serverless (NextGen) collections .

items.title: Amazon MSK Connect now supports pausing and resuming connectors
items.blurb: Amazon MSK Connect (Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka Connect) now supports pausing and resuming connectors, letting you temporarily pause a connector from processing records and resume it later.

items.title: AWS announces AWS Interconnect - last mile preview with Megaport

items.title: AWS Lambda MicroVMs is now available in 4 additional AWS regions
items.blurb: AWS Lambda MicroVMs is now available in 4 additional AWS Regions: Asia Pacific (Hong Kong), Asia Pacific (Malaysia), Asia Pacific (Thailand), and Europe (Spain). With this launch, you can use Lambda MicroVMs in a total of 14 AWS Regions.
